interaction.prompt: Your team is cycling low and the defense collapsed below the puck. Where should you go as F3?

mc.stem: Your team is cycling low and the defense has collapsed below the puck. As F3 drifting through the middle, what is the best play?
opts: Drift to the high slot between the circles
Drop low to make it a three-player battle in the corner
Hug the boards and wait for a rim around
Back out to the blue line to protect against a turnover

feedback.right: Yes. With the defense pulled below the puck, the high slot is wide open for a quick scoring chance.
feedback.wrong: Crowding the corner or hugging the boards just adds a body where the defense already is. The vacated high slot is the open ice.

tip: When the defense collapses low, the high slot is the open ice, so fill it.
why: Filling the soft spot the collapsing defenders leave behind turns a low cycle into a scoring chance.
